         case col5
           when @lv_1 then

              case when ( abs( t6~col4 - t5~col4 ) = abs( t6~col3 - t5~col3 ) or

                          t6~col4 = t5~col4 ) and not
                        ( t5~col3 = t6~col3 and t5~col4 = t6~col4 )

                          abs( t6~col4 - t5~col4 ) = 1 )
